title: Language-Informed Flow Matching for Trend-Guided Structure-Based 3D Molecular Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.31009v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Structure-based drug design (SBDD) requires ligands that satisfy both 3D target affinity and 1D chemical validity. Existing controllable generation methods often rely on task-specific fine-tuning or externally imposed sampling-time guidance, adding cost and potentially conflicting with evolving 3D geometric constraints. We propose LiFT, a language-informed cross-modal framework built on Flow Matching for trend-guided 3D molecular generation across both de novo design and scaffold hopping. LiFT uses a "Sense-Evolve-Assemble" agent to generate target-aware SMILES as intermediate chemical conditions, from which a pre-trained chemical foundation model extracts continuous semantic priors. These priors are integrated into geometric generation through a lightweight semantic projector with zero-initialized adaptive normalization for stable cross-modal conditioning. translated_abstract: 结构药物设计（SBDD）需要配体同时满足3D靶点亲和力和1D化学有效性。现有的可控生成方法通常依赖于任务特定的微调或外部施加的采样时引导，这不仅增加了成本，还可能与不断演变的3D几何约束相冲突。我们提出了LiFT，一个基于流匹配构建的语言信息跨模态框架，用于在从头设计和骨架跃迁中实现趋势引导的3D分子生成。LiFT使用“感知-演化-组装”智能体生成靶点感知的SMILES作为中间化学条件，并利用预训练的化学基础模型从中提取连续的语义先验。这些先验通过带有零初始化自适应归一化的轻量级语义投影器集成到几何生成中，以实现稳定的跨模态条件化。我们进一步引入了自条件解耦路由器（SCDR），它对……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出LiFT跨模态框架，通过语言信息引导的流匹配将靶点感知的化学语义先验融入3D分子几何生成过程，实现了趋势引导的基于结构的药物分子设计，同时支持从头设计与骨架跃迁两类任务。
en_tdlr: LiFT is a language-informed cross-modal framework built on flow matching that injects target-aware chemical semantic priors into 3D molecular geometry generation, enabling trend-guided structure-based drug design for both de novo design and scaffold hopping.
